scope: Version 4 round trips with every saved feature, retained template fixtures, safe refusal of unknown features, and a notes-and-devices example
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image, docker --network none
verified_behaviors: Template v1, v2 and v3 fixture files load from disk with tempo 137, levels 35/60 and pitches 48..62; all three give equal content; v3 keeps renamed identities
Every example re-encodes to identical bytes; lanes reference existing tracks and their own devices; note IDs are below the clip counters
Each example with an extra unknown required feature, version 5 or an unexpected top-level field is refused
The examples together use general-session-v1, automation-v1, synth-v1, piano-roll-v1, devices-v1 and device-automation-v1

notes-and-devices.json is rebuilt byte for byte by a Session API script; all three examples open without warnings, launch every scene and export audible stereo; the staged install ships the new example
limits: Imported audio is covered by its own tests, not by a shipped example (no redistributable WAV); the product license is still undecided (#84).
